serviceName: SocialLoop — send invitations from your own domain
description: Authorises SocialLoop to send event invitations from your domain: DKIM, the return-path (MX + SPF), its CNAME fallback, and a DMARC policy.
variableDescription: dkim: the DKIM public key Resend issued for the selector resend._domainkey. mxhost: the return-path MX host (a region-specific SES feedback host). spfrules: the SPF mechanisms for the return-path subdomain, merged into any SPF already there. rsend: the CNAME target for the tracking host.
